info.title: FauxCall Reference Market API — WebSocket quote feed
info.description: Described only in the API's info.description prose: `WS /v1/ws/quotes?api_key=...` is a WebSocket quote feed (not representable in OpenAPI).

get.description: WebSocket (upgrade on GET). Credentials in the `api_key` query parameter. The client sends JSON text messages `{"action": "subscribe", "symbols": ["AAPL"]}` or `{"action": "ping"}`; the server answers with `subscribed`, `quote`, `pong`, `error` and `done` messages.
